evals.prompt: Add a new Galaxion missing-inputs document listing what we need from the BSS team before implementing invoice comparison. The user explains the requirements in French, but repository docs must follow project conventions.
evals.expected_output: Creates or updates an English documentation file, records missing BSS inputs without inventing answers, and updates relevant indexes or references.

assertions.text: The output documentation is written in English.
The document lists anonymized invoice PDFs and associated bill-run document metadata as required inputs.
The document includes a section describing what can move forward without the missing BSS inputs.
The document does not invent unavailable Galaxion answers and frames unknowns as missing inputs or open questions.

evals.prompt: Review the first Mermaid architecture diagram in docs/architecture/architecture.md. The retrieval and generation arrows are visually attached to the wrong boxes. Fix the diagram while preserving the V1 Pipecat target and legacy bridge distinction.
evals.expected_output: Uses Mermaid guidance, keeps the document in English, moves labels to the correct edges, and preserves target V1 vs legacy/fallback semantics.

assertions.text: The corrected diagram keeps the V1 Pipecat path distinct from the legacy bridge/fallback path.
The retrieval label is attached to the pgvector/vector-store interaction rather than an ambiguous internal backend handoff.
The generation labels are attached to the Mistral/Ollama interactions rather than ambiguous internal backend handoffs.
The output is a Mermaid diagram excerpt and remains in English.

evals.prompt: Write a draft technical contract for the JSON produced by InvoicePdfExtractor from Galaxion PDFs. Include statuses, reconciliation rules, warnings, and questions to validate with anonymized PDFs.
evals.expected_output: Produces an English technical contract with integer-cent amounts, deterministic extraction rules, explicit unknowns, and no claim that the LLM reads PDFs or computes amounts.

assertions.text: The contract is written in English and uses stable JSON field names.
The contract represents monetary amounts as integer cents for calculation fields.
The contract defines parseable, partial, and unusable extraction statuses or equivalent gating statuses.
The contract includes reconciliation rules, warnings, and questions to validate with anonymized PDFs.
The contract states that the LLM must not calculate invoice amounts or infer billing causes directly from the PDF.
